description: This file defines a singleton enum 'ModelCatalogLoader' for loading, resolving, sanitizing, and caching a JavaScript model catalog. It includes functions for locating the catalog file, sanitizing its content, evaluating it in a JavaScript context, and parsing the 'MODELS' object into Swift data structures.

methods.name: load(from:)
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the model catalog from the specified path, evaluates and sanitizes the JavaScript content, extracts 'MODELS', and returns sorted ModelChoice objects.

methods.name: resolveDefaultPath()
methods.description: Determines the default path to the model catalog, prioritizing cached, bundle, or node_modules locations.

methods.name: resolvePath(preferred:)
methods.description: Resolves the actual path to use for the catalog, falling back to other locations if the preferred file is not found.

methods.name: bundleCatalogPath()
methods.description: Returns the path to the bundled 'models.generated.js' resource within the app bundle if available.

methods.name: nodeModulesCatalogPath()
methods.description: Searches for the catalog within 'node_modules' directories relative to project root or current directory.

methods.name: cacheCatalog(sourcePath:)
methods.description: Caches the source catalog file to the designated cache path, creating directories as needed.

methods.name: sanitize(source:)
methods.description: Extracts and cleans the 'MODELS' object from the JavaScript source string, removing certain patterns for safe evaluation.
